tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Find IbiPoint eSIM plans for a destination (country or region). Returns the best-value plans sorted by IbiPoint Data Rating, with prices and a direct link. Use when a user wants mobile data abroad.

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Full details for one IbiPoint plan by product id: data, validity, network, top-up support, transparency, reviews and link.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Hand the customer to the IbiPoint shop to buy one plan. Returns buy_url (the product page where they tap Buy now to pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, with an optional discount code) plus the plan name and price. No account needed; the eSIM is emailed right after payment. There is no in-cha
